definitions.TI: both photons pass tight ID AND tight isolation
definitions.NTI: at least one photon fails tight ID or fails tight isolation
definitions.SF1xSF2: per-event weight of an NTI sideband event used as the continuum proxy in the 125 +/- 2 GeV signal window

counts.TI_signal_window_yield: BLINDED (observed TI data in 125 +/- 2 GeV is never inspected)

nti_scale_factors.nti_control_shape_policy: NTI control-shape distributions retain entries in 120-130 GeV. The 120-130 GeV blinding/removal policy applies ONLY to observed TI data.

background_mixture.continuum: NTI observed-data sidebands 105-120 and 130-160 GeV, weighted by SF1*SF2

signal_definition.weight: SM-normalised MC weight: xsec[pb] * k-factor * filter efficiency / signed generator-weight sum * generator weight * available per-event scale factors (pileup, photon, b-tag, JVT), scaled to the observed-data luminosity
